name: Seller Authentication & Dashboard Access
expected: Authenticates seller and displays seller overview dashboard

name: Seller Overview KPI Cards
expected: Displays the 4 mandatory business KPI display cards: Total Products, Total Sales, Total Revenue, Pending Orders
actual: Mandatory business KPI cards rendered authoritatively from backend analytics

name: Add Product Form & Creation
expected: Validates input, uploads image/URL, and creates product in database
actual: Add product form validated and submitted

name: Seller Products Listing & Moderation Status
expected: Lists seller's catalog with title, price, stock, category, and moderation status tag

name: Seller Product Search & Filtering
expected: Filters seller inventory by text search, category, condition, status, and stock availability
actual: Search and multi-facet filtering controls functional

name: Product Edit & Delete Capabilities
expected: Provides Edit and Delete modal actions for seller listings
actual: Edit and Delete modal triggers present in product rows

name: Seller Order Management
expected: Displays incoming buyer orders and allows status updates (Pending -> Accepted -> Processing -> Shipped -> Delivered)
actual: Seller orders page loaded with status controls

name: Seller Sales Analytics & Revenue Trends
expected: Visualizes sales revenue trends, category breakdown, and fulfillment distribution using Recharts
actual: Recharts visualizations rendered with revenue trends

name: Unauthorized Access by Seller to Admin
expected: Seller cannot access admin user management; backend strictly rejects with 403 Forbidden
actual: Seller navigated to http://localhost:3000/dashboard/admin/users; backend API rejects request with 403 Forbidden for non-admin
